jobs.title: Allied Universal is hiring: Armed Security Officer - Security Clearance in Fort Worth
jobs.description:
SECURITY OFFICER ARMED VEHICLE PATROL SECURITY CLEARANCE
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose.
While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.
As a Security Officer Armed Vehicle Patrol Security Clearance in Fort Worth, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Aero/Defense, and more.
Join Allied Universal as an armed patrol officer at a leading aerospace and defense location, where you will monitor and patrol assigned areas, remain visible to help deter security-related incidents, and deliver outstanding customer service and communication.
This driving post offers the opportunity to support a dynamic environment with professionalism, teamwork, and integrity while contributing to a caring, reliable, and innovative culture.
Position Type: Full Time
Pay Rate: $27.32 / Hour
Job
Schedule:
* Mon: 02:00 PM - 10:00 PM
* Wed: 02:00 PM - 10:00 PM
* Thur: 02:00 PM - 10:00 PM
* Fri: 02:00 PM - 10:00 PM
* Sat: 02:00 PM - 10:00 PM
WHAT YOU'LL DO
* Provide customer service to personnel, visitors, and/or contractors by carrying out security-related procedures, site‑specific policies, and when appropriate, emergency response activities at an aerospace and defense location.
* Respond to incidents, alarms, and/or critical situations in a calm, problem‑solving manner, documenting observations and communicating with site contacts and Allied Universal leadership as needed.
* Conduct regular and random armed patrols throughout buildings, restricted areas, and perimeter zones to help deter unauthorized access and/or unusual activity.
* Monitor entry and exit points, verify credentials and/or authorizations, and report policy violations, hazards, and suspicious behavior in accordance with post orders and applicable regulations.
* Support access control, incident reporting, and emergency preparedness activities while working in environments and conditions that may vary across the location.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
* Possess at least 2 years of security‑related experience.
* Possess 3 or more years of combined law enforcement, military, and/or security‑related experience or a college degree.
* Possess an active DoD Secret Clearance.
* Be at least 21 years of age.
* A valid driver’s license is required in accordance with Allied Universal driver policy requirements.
* Possess a Level III Armed Certification in Texas only.
* Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
* As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
* Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
* As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
* Participate in industry‑specific security training programs.
* Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
WHY JOIN US
* Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
* Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
* Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
* Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.
Allied Universal® is an
Equal Opportunity Employer.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law.
For more information: www.aus.com.

While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.



Life doesn’t always follow a fixed schedule. That’s why we created the Security Officer – Part Time Enhanced position: a flexible, dependable option for individuals looking to supplement their income, gain hands-on experience, or work toward a full-time career with the industry leader.

As a Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Armed Patrol Driver in Fort Worth, TX, this role is designed to provide reliable, consistent hours at an assigned site with the flexibility for you to earn more by picking-up additional shifts when it works for you.

Pay Rate: $20.74 / Hour

Job Schedule:

DayTime
Mon08:00 AM - 12:00 PM
Thur08:00 AM - 12:00 PM

How This Role Works:

  • Fixed-Shift Commitment (“Anchor Shifts”): You will be hired for a designated site and weekly shift that serves as your reliable base schedule. This assignment requires a six (6) month commitment.
  • Earn More, Claim-A-Shift Program: In addition to your fixed shift, you may pick-up extra shifts through our scheduling platform, allowing you to increase earnings and gain experience across multiple sites. Work part-time hours this week and full-time the next. It’s all up to you.

This role is ideal for candidates seeking part-time employment with flexibility, income stability, and opportunities to build-up to a full-time schedule of up to 40 hours per week; always with the option to scale back when needed.

  • Conduct regular and random armed patrols of transit facilities, platforms, parking areas, vehicles, and surrounding perimeters, with working environments and conditions varying by location.
  • Monitor access points and observe activity throughout assigned areas, reporting unusual conditions, policy violations, hazards, and suspicious activity according to site procedures.
  • Maintain required reports, incident documentation, and communications while following applicable laws, client policies, Allied Universal procedures, and post orders.

  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Participate in industry-specific security training programs.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.
